request.subject: PORTRAIT:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn it into a small old-fashioned wooden submarine: the open hull becomes one closed fat cigar-shaped hull of the same pale birch planks with light steel bands and two round glass portholes; remove the mast and the sail; on top a short round conning tower painted bright red with a thin steel periscope and a small red pennant; a red tail fin at the stern. Keep the size, thick black outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
